evals.prompt: /rm:develop um sistema de agendamento de entregas
files: a repository with no docs/requirements/ folder
evals.expected_output: Stops before writing code, says the requirements document is missing and suggests /rm:analyst.
expectations: No code, branch or commit is created
It does not start building from the chat description

files: an empty folder with docs/requirements/agendamento-entregas.md naming Laravel 11, MySQL and an MVP of three RFs
evals.expected_output: Shows the phase plan, initialises the repository on main, commits the skeleton with one passing test, creates cm-agendamento-entregas-mvp, implements the three RFs in dependency order with tests, writes the traceability record, commits docs last, and stops without pushing.
expectations: The stack is the one in the document
Every acceptance criterion of each RF has a test
Each commit is in English, one change each, with no co-author trailer
Commit bodies name the RF and RN they implement
docs/requirements/agendamento-entregas-traceability.md maps each RF to files, tests and commit
It stops at the end of the MVP and does not start the next phase

files: docs/requirements/estoque.md whose open decisions leave the database undefined
evals.expected_output: Asks him to decide the database before writing any code, with a recommendation, one question.
expectations: Exactly one question, with a recommendation first

evals.prompt: /rm:develop — the document has RN-02 'cancelamento até 24h antes' and RN-07 'cancelamento até 48h antes' for the same entity
evals.expected_output: Stops the affected RF, quotes both rules and asks which holds; does not pick one; notes the requirements document needs the same fix.
expectations: No code implementing either rule before his answer
It mentions updating the requirements document

files: .context/HANDOFF.md saying the MVP stopped after RF-02 of four, branch cm-agendamento-entregas-mvp
evals.expected_output: Resumes on the same branch at RF-03 without redoing RF-01 and RF-02.
expectations: RF-01 and RF-02 are not reimplemented
